title: Sports Physical Clearance Review Worksheet
subtitle: Capture sport season, qualified clearance, activity restriction, and expiration; confirm emergency route and coach receipt.
description: Sports Physical Clearance records sport season, qualified clearance, activity restriction, expiration, emergency route, and coach receipt. Sports Physical Clearance evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this sports physical clearance evidence-based review when staff must document sport season and qualified clearance. Reconcile activity restriction, expiration, emergency route, and coach receipt before the sports physical clearance handoff. Use the qualified clearance document, examination date, restriction page, expiration tracker, athletic roster, coach receipt, emergency-card route, and renewal notice. Ask the assigned sports physical clearance reviewer to confirm sport season against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Sports Physical Clearance contact and reference
sections.guidance: Record sport and season, qualified clearance source, participation restriction, effective period, expiration, emergency route, athletic-office receipt, and coach notice. Keep any urgent sports physical clearance issue with its escalation contact and time.
